issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method that uses the shared stock (explicitly listed as one of the methods that must be static). In the solution implementation (SealSaloon.java) calculateTotalPrice is declared as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)). This mismatch (static vs instance) can confuse students about whether the method should be static and how it should be called (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs instance.calculateTotalPrice(...)), and whether it should operate on the shared static stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature match the specification: change the solution to declare calculateTotalPrice as static (e.g., public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update any call sites accordingly (call as SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) or ensure tests use the static form). Alternatively, if the intended design is to allow an instance method, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static and clarify the intended usage.
